title: Test suite and tools docs fixes
goal: The ids baseline names the renamed land e2e test, so perfcheck ids --against reports no MISSING for it; perfcheck names_successor refuses a dropped test's class, full id or bare parametrized name as its own successor; the land e2e scenario builds its backlog from fixture items, so a live item cannot fail it; the unit cache test fails when _unit_key drops path or text; tools.md claims no perfcheck tests that do not exist; tools.md's intake row names the test.run row a drift check's tests.py run writes to the clone's spool; committed_calls keeps the newest call rows within its read budget.

gates.question: Approve this sprint's goal and committed items?
